root_cause.text: The `alps_raw_event()` function in the hid-alps driver lacks a check for `HID_CLAIMED_INPUT` before using `hdata->input`, which can be NULL if the device hasn't been properly claimed, leading to a NULL pointer dereference.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `if (!(hdev->claimed & HID_CLAIMED_INPUT) || !hdata->input) return 0;` to prevent processing when the input device is not claimed or the input pointer is NULL.
